up: Find all compound records (molecule_chembl_id, molregno, record_id, doc_id, compound_name) that are reported in the publication with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5727368. The query should return each compound record once, even if the document contains multiple assay activities for the same molecule. No filtering on activity type, units, values, assay confidence, organism, or target type is required. The document may contain activities without structures, but still include the molecule identifiers (molregno and molecule_chembl_id).
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_chembl_id, a.molregno, a.record_id, a.doc_id, cr.compound_name
FROM activities a
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
WHERE a.doc_id = (SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5727368');

up: Retrieve every molecule that has at least one activity (activity_id, assay_id, etc.) reported in the document with ChEMBL identifier CHEMBL5727368. Return each qualifying compound only once, showing the internal numeric identifiers (molregno), the ChEMBL identifier of the molecule (CHEMBL ID), the compound record identifier (record_id) and the textual compound name. Ensure that duplicate molecules (same molregno) that appear multiple times in the same document are collapsed to a single row. No additional filtering on assay type, units, activity values, confidence scores, target assignments or organism is required; include all activity rows that belong to the specified document.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.molregno, md.chembl_id, a.record_id, cr.compound_name
FROM activities a
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE a.doc_id = (SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5727368');
